name: ohb-integrated-report-system
description: Centralized reporting and monitoring system for the Oromia Health Bureau

scripts.dev: npm run db:up:wait && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @ohb/api && npm run build --workspace @ohb/web
